verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a distributed task queue whose separate control plane schedules tasks and coordinates execution across independently running workers, and the founder describes scaling with many workers pulling from a backlog. Automatic retries and durability suggest failed work can be recovered, but no evidence shows explicit load-balancing or reassignment of tasks when a worker is lost. missing for 10: documented worker load-balancing or assignment strategy, explicit worker-failure detection and task reassignment (heartbeats/timeouts), horizontal-scaling guidance or benchmarks, independent hands-on corroboration.
